II_120.definition: Insulinemic index: per-subject 0-120 min serum insulin iAUC (trapezoid; below-baseline handling not stated) relative to the reference sandwich = 100, then averaged; mean +/- SEM. Normalised mean of individual indices, NOT a ratio of native means.
II_120.source_statement: No significant differences were found between the meals neither in insulinemic index (II in %)

insulin_iAUC_0_30.source_statement: In the early postprandial phase, expressed as iAUC 0-30 min, the W+5AA resulted in a higher insulin response compared to the reference and S
